{{Quote|They've gone mad. They're destroying droids all over the city!''"<br />"''They aren't mad. They're just frightened. The Yuuzhan Vong are on Ando, and may well conquer the planet.|A [[Unidentified 3D-4 administrative droid|3D-4 droid]] and [[Dorsk 82]]|<ref name="EoV:C" />}}
In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders '''invaded''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. However the Yuuzhan Vong issued an ultimatum and ordered to surrender a member of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] and destroy all [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on the planet in return for the cessation of the attack. The native [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] began to destroy droids to appease the invaders. In [[Imthitill]], droids were exterminated all over the city using a massive [[Fire/Legends|fire]] but [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Dorsk 82]] intended to leave the planet with thirty-eight droids. He was then killed when his [[Dorsk 82's starship|starship]] was shot down upon takeoff by [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]]. Nevertheless this was ignored by [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] and an invasion and occupation of their planet ensued.<ref name="EoV:C" />
